izzyondroid:com.dresos.dressecurecomms.name: DresSecureComms
izzyondroid:com.dresos.dressecurecomms.summary: De-Googled secure comms: private SMS, calls, contacts, spam shield, file scan.
izzyondroid:com.dresos.dressecurecomms.description:
DresSecureComms is a FOSS, de-Googled, all-in-one secure communications app. It works fully offline for SMS and calls, with no Google services and no trackers.
 Features:
 Messages: a private offline SMS client. Send and receive normal texts, or turn on encryption per message. Encrypted messages use AES-256-GCM and only work between two people who both use this app and share the same key. Keys are set per contact, so every person can have their own code. Includes photo sharing, group messages, search, and contact suggestions when you start a new message.
 Calls: dial any number or call a saved contact over your normal carrier line. The call log is searchable, the screen turns off when you hold the phone to your ear, and you can block or unblock any number straight from the log.
 Spam Shield: screens incoming calls before your phone rings. Rejects premium rate numbers, silences short codes, and flags callers faking the first digits of your own number. Saved contacts always ring through, and everything it blocks is listed in Settings so you can undo it. It runs entirely on the device, so no number is ever sent anywhere to be checked.
 Contacts: an encrypted local vault, stored with the Android Keystore. Add contacts by hand or import them from the device.
 Threat Scan: check a URL against VirusTotal using your own free API key.
 File Scan: check a single file, one app, or every app on your device against VirusTotal. Only the SHA-256 fingerprint is sent, and that is checked against seventy or more antivirus engines at once. If VirusTotal has never seen a file, you can choose to upload that one file for analysis. It always asks first, and a sweep of your apps never uploads anything.
 Metadata Wipe: strip GPS and EXIF data from a photo before you share it.
 Geo Spoofer: set a mock GPS location, or have the app pick a random one.
 App Lock: biometric or device PIN.
 Block Screenshots: stop screenshots and screen recording inside the app.
 Encryption covers SMS text only. Pictures and group messages are sent unencrypted for now, the same as any normal messaging app, so they arrive readable on any phone.
 We need your help to battle Google and its restrictions so if you use any of our projects, services or apps and it works for you then please tell a Friend to tell a Friend about us.
 Part of the DresOS Android privacy and defensive-security project.
 Website: https://dresos.org
 Donate: https://ko-fi.com/dresos
 Source: https://github.com/The-DresOS-Foundation/DresSecureComms

fdroid:dev.shrekbytes.waqfah.fdroid.description:
Waqfah shows a single Quranic ayah before the apps you choose. When you open a monitored app, the reading screen appears first. Read the ayah or skip it, continue into the app, and get on with your day.
Waqfah does not block apps, set limits, or track usage. There are no accounts and no servers: everything works offline except the optional download of an extra translation.
READING
• Sequential reading — resuming at your lowest unread ayah — or random reading, with progress tracked across all 6,236 ayat.
• Indopak and Uthmani scripts, two bundled Arabic fonts, and adjustable text sizes.
• Optional transliteration and translations in English or Bengali, with more available as downloads.
• Browse any surah, see your per-surah progress, and jump to any ayah.
THE PAUSE
• You choose exactly which apps get a pause.
• A per-app cooldown — or Off — sets the gap before the same app is paused again.
• One reading screen per app open. Never during calls, never on quick switch-backs. Share-sheet and "Open with" entries never count.
• Skipping is one tap, and never held against you.
LOOK AND FEEL
• Seven themes, five accent colours.
• English and Bengali interface, or follow the system language.
PRIVACY
Waqfah collects nothing and sends nothing anywhere. Monitored apps, reading progress, and preferences stay on the device. There are no ads, no analytics, and no trackers. The only network request is an optional translation download that you explicitly start, fetched over HTTPS and verified against a pinned checksum before use.
Waqfah cannot read what is inside other apps: it requests no accessibility or screen-content permissions.
PERMISSIONS
Usage access tells Waqfah which app moved to the foreground, so the reading screen appears at the right moment. Display over other apps lets the reading screen appear over the app that is opening. Notifications keep the required background-service notification visible. Run at startup restarts the monitor after a reboot, but only if Waqfah is toggled on and its permissions are still granted.
CREDITS
The Quran text and the bundled translations come from the Tanzil Project (tanzil.net), used under Tanzil's terms with attribution. The bundled Arabic fonts, Amiri and Digital Khatt Indopak, are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; their licence texts ship inside the app.
Waqfah is free software, licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0.

fdroid:io.davidar.fabularium.name: Fabularium
fdroid:io.davidar.fabularium.description:
Create and play interactive fiction on your Android phone or tablet. Also known as text adventures, interactive books, playable novels, z-machine, glulx, tads, terps. Fun for adults and also a great way to encourage children to read and develop their imaginations.
Fabularium can play all of the major formats: Adrift (including version 5), AdvSys, the Adventure Game Toolkit (AGT), Alan (2 and 3), Glulx, Hugo, Level 9, Magnetic Scrolls, Scott Adams Adventures (Scottfree), Tads (2 and 3) and Zcode (Infocom). It also includes a simple integrated development environment (IDE) for creating your own Glulx, Tads 3 and Zcode games.
Fabularium supports Unicode games, so if you would prefer to play in a language other than English, no problems! Either define your own keyboard via the keyboards.ini file (see examples in that file) or disable the built-in keyboard via the settings, to use your system keyboard. Keyboards defined via keyboards.ini can have multiple layouts and each key can be programmed to generate one Unicode character, a complete command, or even multiple commands, that are fed to the interpreter one by one. As with anything else in fab.ini, you can set the different keyboards you've defined in keyboards.ini to automatically load with different game and terp combinations.
Fabularium takes accessibility seriously. Much of the app is now TalkBack enabled and the built-in keyboard supports "explore by touch" and "lift to type" technology. Accessibility features will continue to improve over the coming releases. If you are blind or vision-impaired and would like to help me with this (e.g. testing and feature suggestions), let me know.
We care about typography! While the default settings should work for most games, Fabularium is also highly customisable. Make the margins as narrow or as wide as you want. Don't like the default fonts and colours? Change them. Adjust line spacing. Fiddle with other typographical features. Optimise that game for your device's screen. For maximum screen space, try using a hardware keyboard.
Fabularium is and always will be completely free, with no ads, and open source. It does not come bundled with any games; you will need to obtain these separately. There are many games freely available at www.ifdb.tads.org and www.ifarchive.org. You can download these games anywhere to your internal storage/SD card and then add them to your library from within the app. The app is also able to extract files from ZIP archives.
Inspired by the great Gargoyle interpreter by Tor Andersson, Fabularium implements Andrew Plotkin's Glk 0.7.5 spec in Android and can therefore support any glk-enabled interpreter. More interpreters may be added in the future.
For further information see the in-app help.

* Self-voicing for custom fan voice-overs

* Updated engine and other under the hood technical improvements

Brogue is a single-player strategy game set in the halls of a mysterious and
 randomly-generated dungeon. The objective is simple enough -- retrieve the fabled
 Amulet of Yendor from the 26th level -- but the dungeon is riddled with danger.
 Horrifying creatures and devious, trap-ridden terrain await. Yet it is also
 riddled with weapons, potions, and artifacts of forgotten power. Survival demands
 strength and cunning in equal measure as you descend, making the most of what the
 dungeon gives you. You will make sacrifices, narrow escapes, and maybe even some
 friends along the way -- but will you be one of the lucky few to return alive?

flathub:com.rustdesk.RustDesk.description:
RustDesk is a full-featured open source remote control alternative for self-hosting and security
 with minimal configuration.
 Works on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, Web.
 Supports VP8 / VP9 / AV1 software codecs, and H264 / H265 hardware codecs.

flathub:io.github.Qalculate.summary: Powerful and easy to use calculator
flathub:io.github.Qalculate.description:
Qalculate! is a multi-purpose cross-platform desktop calculator.

flathub:io.github.hvdwofl.jExifToolGUI.name: jExifToolGUI
flathub:io.github.hvdwofl.jExifToolGUI.description:
jExifToolGUI is a java/Swing Windows/Linux/MacOS graphical frontend for the excellent command-line application called ExifTool by Phil Harvey.
 ExifTool is a platform-independent Perl command-line application and library for reading, writing and editing meta information in a wide variety of files. Exiftool is by far the best and most extensive metadata tool available! It reads and writes metadata information from/to many files, but primarily focuses on photos/images. It reads/writes exif, gps, xmp, maker notes for many cameras, JFIF, GeoTIFF, ICC Profile, Photoshop IRB, FlashPix and many, many more tags. It can use a "reference" image to write the tags to a multiple set of photos or a complete directory containing photos. Author/creator/maintainer of ExifTool: Phil Harvey.
 jExifToolGui is a java/Swing program that functions as a graphical frontend (GUI) for exiftool. Many thanks go to Phil Harvey for his excellent tool. Without ExifTool, this jExifToolGui Graphical frontend for ExifTool would never have existed.
 jExifToolGui is (just) a graphical frontend for ExifTool. It can use a "reference" image to write the tags to a multiple set of photos, like gps tags for photos that were taken at the same location but somehow miss or contain the incorrect gps info. jExifToolGUI also contains extensive renaming functionality based on the exif info in your photos. This jExifToolGUI program is free, Open Source software: you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version.

flathub:org.jousse.vincent.Pomodorolm.description:
Concentré (formerly Pomodorolm) is a simple, good looking and configurable focus timer. Work

flathub:page.codeberg.lazyt.ubpm.name: Universal Blood Pressure Manager
flathub:page.codeberg.lazyt.ubpm.description:
A program to manage your blood pressure data locally and privately, without the constraints of the manufacturer's cloud.
 The following features are implemented:

gnome-extensions:weather-prime@weather-p.name: Weather Prime
gnome-extensions:weather-prime@weather-p.summary:
Weather Prime brings a polished, full-featured weather station to your GNOME top bar. A clean pill shows current conditions at a glance, and a single click opens a rich, tabbed drop-down packed with everything from live radar to tide times.
☀️ CURRENT CONDITIONS
• Temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind, gusts, dew point, visibility, and cloud cover
• Barometric pressure with a smart trend arrow that hints at incoming weather
• Last-24h precipitation total with an hour-by-hour sparkline, plus a separate snowfall depth when it's snowing
📈 FORECASTS
• Hourly — a 12-hour outlook with temperature, precipitation chance, humidity, and wind
• 7-Day — daily highs and lows, precipitation, humidity, and wind, plus a plain-language daily narrative for US locations (NWS, keyless)
🌬️ AIR QUALITY
• Pick AirNow (US EPA AQI per pollutant), OpenWeatherMap (global 1–5 AQI plus all eight pollutants), or Open-Meteo PM2.5 / PM10
• Automatic source fallback so you always see a reading
🌙 ASTRONOMY
• Sunrise and sunset, moonrise and moonset, moon phase, and illumination — no key required
• Solar noon plus the dates of the next new and full moon (keyless USNO data)
• Optional tide line showing today's high and low times (NOAA, US coastal, keyless)
🗺️ LIVE RADAR MAP
• Animated RainViewer precipitation radar (past frames + nowcast) layered over Esri satellite imagery
• Play/pause control; one click launches Windy, Zoom Earth, Ventusky, RainViewer, Weather.com, Wunderground, or NWS Radar for full interactivity
⚠️ SEVERE-WEATHER ALERTS
• Live NWS alerts surface automatically for US locations, complete with the full alert text
⚙️ MADE YOUR WAY
• Auto-locate via GeoClue2, or set your spot manually with built-in city search
• Theme follows your system light/dark setting — or pin it the way you like
• Panel sits left, center, or right at original, medium (1.25×), or large (1.5×) size — and the drop-down can hang from the pill or pin to any corner, edge, or center of the screen
• Independently configurable refresh cadence for weather, air quality, and radar
✨ Works out of the box — no API keys, no signup, no fees. Optional free keys from WeatherAPI.com, WeatherAI.io, AirNow, and OpenWeatherMap unlock the extra providers whenever you want them.

You can use BeanShell interactively for Java experimentation and debugging or as a simple scripting engine for your applications. Another way to describe it is to say that in many ways BeanShell is to Java as Tcl/Tk is to C: BeanShell is embeddable - You can call BeanShell from your Java applications to execute Java code dynamically at run-time or to provide scripting extensibility for your applications. fedora-packages:engauge-digitizer/engaug.description: The Engauge Digitizer tool accepts image files (like PNG, JPEG and TIFF) containing graphs, and recovers the data points from those graphs. The resulting data points are usually used as input to other software applications. Conceptually, Engauge Digitizer is the opposite of a graphing tool that converts data points to graphs. The process is shown below - an image file is imported, digitized within Engauge, and exported as a table of numeric data to a text file. Work can be saved into an Engauge DIG file. New features already added to Engauge: - Grid lines are displayed for fine adjustments of the axis points that define the coordinate systems - Automated line and point extraction rapidly digitizes data - Image processing for separating important details from background information - Undo/redo of all operations means recovering from mistakes and experimenting with options is painless - Installers for Windows and OSX operating systems, and repository packages for Linux make installation easy - Wizard provides an interactive tutorial to explain the basic steps - Wizard creates a checklist guide to interactively leads user through steps from file import to file export - Cubic spline interpolation between points gives more accurate curves with fewer points - Axes Checker briefly highlights the axes when they are defined or modified, to reveal entry mistakes - Graph coordinates can be specified as date and time values, or as degrees, minutes and seconds - File import and data export by drag-and-drop and copy/paste - Test suite for regression testing minimizes code breakage as new features are added - Multiple coordinate systems in the same image can be digitized in advanced mode - Axes with only one known coordinate (floating axes) can be digitized in advanced mode - Geometry Window displays geometric information about the selected curve - Curve Fitting Window fits a polynomial function to the selected curve

firefox-addons:3069530.name: Arn Manga LLM Translator
firefox-addons:3069530.summary: Read manga, manhwa & webtoons in your language — detection, OCR & rendering run on-device; translate with your own LLM key (BYOK)
firefox-addons:3069530.description:
Arn Manga LLM Translator machine-translates manga, manhwa and webtoons in your browser with zero developer servers . Point it at any reader and it will:
 Detect speech bubbles and text (comic-text-detector, ONNX) — on your device.
 Read the text with OCR (Japanese, Korean, Chinese, English) or a vision LLM.
 Translate it with the LLM you choose — OpenAI-compatible, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic or Gemini — using your own API key . A character book and recent-page memory keep names, pronouns and tone consistent across a chapter.
 Render the translation back into the original bubbles, in reading order.
Everything except the LLM call runs locally: detection, OCR, panel ordering, drawing, per-page caching and the character book. Revisits are instant because results are content-hash cached.
Works on most image- and canvas-based readers, including single-image readers with preloading. Optional cloud inference offloads detection+OCR to an endpoint you deploy yourself (one-click Colab → your own Modal account) for machines that can't run it locally.
 Bring your own key. Keys stay in your browser's local storage and page images are sent only to the endpoint you configure. No accounts, no analytics, no ads.
Source (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/c0ffeeOverdose/arn-manga-llm-translator

firefox-addons:2675569.description: Scientific Journals often require multiple clicks to go from the landing page for an article, to downloading the pdf of the article; once downloaded, these pdf's often have random strings of characters as names. firefox-addons:971112.name: Image Downloader
firefox-addons:971112.summary: Easily save all images in a website to a zip file with just one click!
firefox-addons:971112.description:
Image Downloader is an addon that lets you easily find and download all images on a website to a single ZIP file. 
Simply click on the toolbar button to open the app interface (in a new tab). Within the interface, you can see the list of fetched images for the current tab. To open the UI in the toolbar popup, please right click on the toolbar button and then mark the - Open in popup - checkbox. On the left side, you can see the list of available options. To download images to your computer, please select an image(s) and then click on the download button on the top-left corner.
Please note that the download location is the default location in your browser. Moreover, for each step, a desktop notification will show up containing information about the current state.
If you have a bug report or a feature request, please fill the bug report form on the add-on's homepage .

firefox-addons:2651222.name: Tab Discard (Suspender)
firefox-addons:2651222.summary: Easily suspend inactive tabs and save up memory for your browser.
firefox-addons:2651222.description:
Tab Discard (Suspender) is an addon that lets you easily suspend all inactive tabs with just one click. 
Suspending tabs can greatly reduce the memory and speeds up your browser. When you click on a suspended tab (make it active) it will be loaded with the previous content automatically. 
This addon is useful when you have several open tabs, you can suspend them all (free up the memory) with just one click and then visit them one-by-one to unsuspend. This way, your browser will use the least amount of memory and have better performance.
To report bugs, please visit the addon's homepage and fill the bug report form.

firefox-addons:2989519.name: Dark Ritual (dark theme)
firefox-addons:2989519.summary: Ultra lightweight dark theme, very efficient and CPU-friendly
firefox-addons:2989519.description:
Dark Ritual is an ultra lightweight Firefox dark mode add-on that applies a site-wide dark theme that is very efficient and uses very few smart styling rules. It lets you control background color, text color, image/media brightness, and an optional daily schedule.
I built it because Dark Reader was giving me performance issues in an old laptop and because I don't need so many features while also making a lot of calculations when the only thing I need is to comfortably look at the screen at night, I don't need the dark theme to be perfect at the cost of slowness and battery drain on my laptop.
Features
 Minimal stylesheet changes to reduce CPU usage
 Fast dark-mode injection to reduce white flashes on navigation
 Customizable background and text colors
 Adjustable image/media brightness for darkened pages
 Optional time-based activation with overnight schedule support
 Instant updates across open tabs after changing settings
 Visible keyboard focus styling for accessibility
 Lightweight packaged assets and optimized add-on icons
Functionality
Dark Ritual works by injecting a global stylesheet into pages and keeping that stylesheet in sync with your saved preferences. A background script maintains startup styling for active sessions, while the popup lets you enable or disable the add-on, choose colors, adjust media brightness, and configure an automatic schedule.
Settings are stored locally in Firefox. The add-on does not declare any data collection.
Permissions
 storage : stores your preferences locally
 alarms : checks schedule transitions once per minute
 tabs : broadcasts updated settings to open tabs so changes apply immediately

firefox-addons:2757717.description: This extension will scan pages in your tabs to find if they set a `theme-color` meta tag, and paint the browser frame in that color, much like some mobile browsers would. This extension might be useful for developers trying to debug theme-color behaviour in their websites and apps.

firefox-addons:3063015.name: Swagger UI Dark Theme
firefox-addons:3063015.summary: A modern dark theme for Swagger UI with automatic detection and developer-focused customization.
firefox-addons:3063015.description:
Swagger UI Dark Theme
Transform Swagger UI into a clean, modern dark interface designed for developers. Automatically detect Swagger UI pages and apply a carefully crafted dark theme with customizable colors and developer-focused UI improvements.
AUTOMATIC SWAGGER UI DETECTION
The extension automatically recognizes Swagger UI pages and applies the theme without requiring manual configuration. It also supports dynamically rendered Swagger UIs, including documentation loaded by modern SPAs.
FEATURES
• Automatic Swagger UI detection — no manual URL configuration required
• Customizable dark theme — create your own visual style
• Modern dark interface — designed for comfortable long development sessions
• HTTP method colors — clearly distinguish GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE operations
• Enhanced Swagger UI components — custom styling for operations, parameters, responses, models, schemas, forms, and buttons
• Authentication dialogs — improved styling for authorization and authentication forms
• Custom modals and code blocks — dark styling for dialogs, JSON examples, and response sections
• Styled scrollbars — consistent dark scrollbars throughout Swagger UI
• Endpoint URL copying — quickly copy the full API endpoint URL from an operation path
• Dynamic Swagger support — works with Swagger UI loaded after the initial page render
• Works across environments — localhost, development, staging, and production
BUILT FOR DEVELOPERS
Make API documentation easier on the eyes while keeping it practical and consistent.
Whether you're working with FastAPI, OpenAPI documentation, local development environments, staging servers, or production APIs, Swagger UI Dark Theme provides a polished and developer-friendly experience.
Designed for developers who spend hours working with API documentation and want a cleaner, more comfortable Swagger UI experience.

apple-macos:6828281143.name: Road Trip: Family Travel
apple-macos:6828281143.description:
Road Trip gets the whole family out the door ready: every person and pet packed, the house secured, the bookings confirmed, and one clear answer on travel day: Ready, or what's still in the way.
THE DAY-OF RUNDOWN
• A countdown to the minute you leave, and a plain Ready or Not ready
• Critical items first: medications, passports, keys, the kennel drop-off
• Today's flights, pickups and check-ins in order, with confirmation numbers
A PLAN THAT BUILDS ITSELF
• A timeline from the first idea to travel day: book, confirm, pack, prep the house, go
• Checklists for two days before, the day before and the day of
• Reminders on your device for confirmations, check-in, the kennel, the mail hold and departure
PACKING FOR EVERYONE
• A packing list for each person and each pet, sized to the trip type, the weather and the number of nights
• Shared household items packed once, not five times
• Save a list as a template for the next beach, ski or family-visit trip
BOOKINGS IN ONE PLACE
• Flights, hotels, car rentals and kennels or pet sitters, with confirmation numbers and who's going
• Loyalty and Known Traveler numbers on each person, masked to the last four and copied with one tap
• Keep any trip in your calendar, or share it as a calendar file
THE HOUSE AND THE DOG
• A house prep and security checklist: doors, alarm, thermostat, plants, a key with a neighbor
• Track the USPS mail hold
• Pets get their own packing list, care notes and kennel bookings
LUGGAGE TAGS
• Printable tags for every bag, with a QR code that holds only a random trip ID, never a name or address
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Everything stays on your devices; sync iPhone, iPad and Mac through your own private iCloud, only if you switch it on
• Back up everything to a file you keep
Ask Siri "How long until our trip in Road Trip?"
